text:
mike: Heads-up: PMs reported tenants seeing a v1 sunset banner while their traffic clearly routes to v2. Console shows banner_age=30d but routing traces are v2.

anya: Can you paste a quick example trace + banner event?

mike: banner event from ui:
```
event: show_deprecation_banner
tenant: tenant-221
banner_key: v1_sunset_backfill
```
routing trace for same token <1m later:
```
route: v2
route_reason: live_affinity
header: X-Client-Version: 2
```

reza: This smells like the backfill we ran that wrote tenant.deprec_state = legacy. Renderer reads tenant DB, runtime uses token affinity cache. Theyre out of sync by design.

claire: The bigger problem is billing-preview: some tenants have split usage rows (v1 & v2) for the same hour. Billing flagged it as a potential duplicate.

anya: Duplicates usually come from: ingress mirroring without dedupe key OR backfill emitter re-playing requests without X-Dedupe-Id. Which backfill was that?

mike: backfill job backfill-202408 wrote a lot of telemetry and didn't set dedupe headers. It used emitter v1.0.

reza: Action items:
1) Quick UX: change banner copy to include a tiny hint when runtime_affinity != banner_state: "Your requests are using v2 — ignore this message". Cheap join on renderer.
2) Patch backfill emitter to add `X-Dedupe-Id: backfill-202408-<jobid>` and `X-Meter-Source: backfill`.
3) Add metric `banner_runtime_mismatch_rate` (1m,1h) per tenant.

pm-zoe: PM ask: please also add a small console badge that says "routing: v2" vs banner to reduce confusion.

anya: For billing duplicates: we should run a reconciliation that finds request_ids duplicated across v1/v2 for same tenant+hour and subtract backfill-attributed rows. Patched emitter will prevent future dupes.

mike: Also discovered proxy behavior: when X-Client-Version is present, some old proxies strip unknown headers. We'll add a proxy rule: preserve `X-Client-Version` and forward as `X-Client-Version-Forwarded` to routing service.

reza: I'll cut a tiny change to runtime: shadow paths should preserve `X-Request-Id` so dedupe works end-to-end.

deploy-bot: deploy started: reza/shadow-preserve-reqid -> canary (sha: f9e2aa) :rocket:

claire: UX note: don't hide the banner entirely. Use a low-contrast hint and link to "Why you might see this" article. PMs prefer explicitness.

anya: Telemetry: set sampling 100% for tenants with mismatch>0 for next 24h. We'll emit `version_concordance` too.

mike: Filing follow-ups: ENG-7210 backfill-emitter-dedupe, ENG-7211 renderer-banner-join, ENG-7212 proxy-forward-version, ENG-7213 billing-reconciliation-run. QA will run a smoke on pilot tenants.

pm-zoe: Thanks team. Please ping me when canary completes, I want to flip pilot flag for 50 tenants.
